capability_notes: This checkpoint is pretrained on simple stories; it was not instruction-tuned or evaluated as a question-answering model.

The third question requires pool direction, price impact, slippage, fees and token details; no such live data was supplied to this language model.
No swaps, chain RPC calls, external inference or retraining occurred.
